newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK ETVA BANK ISSUES 3-YR, 11.25PCT COUPON BOND.
newsitem.headline: GREEK ETVA BANK ISSUES 3-YR, 11.25PCT COUPON BOND.

text.p: Greece's state ETVA bank has issued a 3.0 billion, three-year, 11.25 percent coupon bond with public subscriptions ending Tuesday, it said.
Interest income from the bond is subject to a 15 percent withholding tax bringing the net yield to 9.5625 percent, said a senior bank official.
"The bond issue was directed at retailers and has been a success," the senior banker told Reuters. "Subscriptions started yesterday and the target has been comfortably met."

Two-year zeros and 12-month T-bills hit the market today featuring gross rates of 9.50 percent and 9.60 percent respectively. The withholding tax rate for interest income from state bonds is 7.5 percent.
